issues.label: Agent-native semantic GPU debugger and profiler
Deterministic CPU semantic simulator and virtual GPU runtime

capabilities.label: Rust ownership and result flow
capabilities.detail: rustc remains the only Rust borrow checker: it enforces moves, borrows, lifetimes, visibility, and local typestate. Fe2O3 extends those rules with sealed non-Clone GPU capabilities and workload-neutral cross-invocation verification. Typed kernels may return KernelResult and use ?, while the macro emits a private unit-ABI entry wrapper and the compiler retains the helper's real MIR. Err ends only the current invocation and is not a host-visible error channel.

capabilities.label: Pliron context ownership
capabilities.detail: Process-local context identities, registered dialects, and context-bound handles are checked before operations are inspected. Generic safety passes execute today; issue #140 tracks stronger owner-aware upstream arena handles rather than blocking the production verifier sequence.

capabilities.label: Generic pre-lowering safety
capabilities.detail: The fixed eight-pass workload-neutral pre-lowering sequence verifies tensor layout, ranked bounds, atomic legality, cross-invocation race freedom, complete hierarchy ownership, barrier convergence, workgroup-memory initialization/publication, and semantic refinement. It records non-vacuous TotalView and CollectiveContributions counts, reconstructs closed typed scalar roots, validates finite fold, bounded recurrence, and permutation-gather contracts, and retains exact V5 evidence. Rejected and Incomplete findings both stop production compilation before lowering.

capabilities.label: Production and qualification isolation
capabilities.detail: Ordinary safe Rust reaches semantic MIR, ranked PLIRON verification, canonical Kernel IR V7, and formal-memory admission through the sole unselected production route. The current end-to-end GPU executions for dynamic strided GEMM, row softmax, fused attention, and grouped-expert MoE are explicitly selected FE2O3_QUALIFICATION_ORACLE_V1 runs. They share workload-neutral Matrix, Subgroup, Math, ownership, control-flow, and safety machinery, but their capability cannot complete or publish the production transaction. Unsupported effects and ownership forms remain deliberately fail-closed, and the obsolete FE2O3_CODEGEN_PIPELINE selector is rejected.

capabilities.label: Bounded compiler analysis
capabilities.detail: Closed control-flow validation, pruned SSA placement, block-argument uniformity, sparse index facts, dynamic tiled-component reasoning, subgroup-scoped bounded invocation traces with finite loop-carried environments, Result and Option payload dominance, and stable diagnostics feed every workload through the same safety pipeline. Closed typed scalar SSA binds Boolean, signed/unsigned integer, and f32/f64 operators, casts, overflow, rounding, exceptional values, static definedness, and canonical commitments. Collective reconciliation rejects result/witness scalar or policy substitution without recognizing GEMM, softmax, attention, routing, or any other workload. Unsupported operations, nonterminating traces, and resource limits fail closed as Incomplete obligations.

capabilities.label: Safe Rust functional references
capabilities.detail: The completeness integration awaiting the next publication pin runs one generated Verus checker that replays supported exact pointwise integer and compiler-side IEEE operator-DAG formulas from compiler-derived coordinates, domains, preconditions, and values; no generic relation premise supplies equality. PLIRON separately proves and reconciles total coverage, allocation separation, frames, schedules, and ordered-product identity, while a private move-only join requires both structural and formula reports. Policy-checked Checked staging grants no authority. Canonical unit-step loops carry exact termination evidence plus an overflow-safe final latch. Dynamic slice reads are complete only for exact identical symbolic ranked extents or overflow-checked bounded static affine intervals; unrelated independent lengths, missing assertions, unsafe intervals, and overflow fail closed. Noncanonical SCCs produce exact invariant/variant requests that cannot compose with formula authority. Tensor/MFMA result components bind exact scalar policies and stores at the claim boundary, but tensor-component replay is unsupported. ErrorBounded formula replay is also unsupported. mi300x lacks the fixed retained /opt runtime, so no referenced production compile has completed this gate and there is no fallback. Compiler extraction/projection and pass soundness, target IEEE values, LLVM-or-later lowering, target instruction arithmetic, artifacts, launch, hardware, and performance remain outside the claim.

capabilities.label: Target finalization
capabilities.detail: The current qualification route emits gfx942 LLVM, links HSACO, loads it through fe2o3-host, and checks dynamic GEMM, row-softmax, fused-attention, and grouped-expert GPU results against independent CPU references. Disassembly confirms MFMA for matrix contractions and lane shuffles for reductions. The published measurements are correctness qualifications; only the GEMM lesson includes a matched direct HIP comparison, and it does not claim a speed advantage. Protected release authority and complete source-to-machine refinement remain separate.

capabilities.label: Runtime and persistent execution
capabilities.detail: Pure-Rust KFD topology, memory, queue, packet, and typed lifecycle foundations are present. The direct-KFD semantic observation boundary does not dispatch work: its redacted report exposes queue-lifecycle and resource facts only, with no dispatch identity, timing, KIR, workgroup, wave, lane, memory, or register observation. Current production publication and load custody use Worker V3; Worker V2 application routing is retired and retained only in historical or qualification evidence. These records grant no completed load, launch, or persistent-execution authority; verified persistent execution and complete production runtime authority remain open in issues #135 and #137.

capabilities.label: Semantic debugging and profiling
capabilities.detail: Versioned semantic trace records, deterministic bounded hierarchy queries, and import boundaries establish an agent-readable foundation. The importer can retain selected rocprofv3 JSON dispatch-envelope and timing observations, ATT manifest metadata without decoded events, and sparse normalized ROCgdb records with explicit unavailable fields. There is no debugger or profiler UI, general source/MIR/KIR/ISA map, counter or PC-sample ingestion, ATT decoding, structured ROCgdb state, capture comparison, or diagnosis authority yet. Issue #215 tracks those layers.

capabilities.label: No-GPU CPU semantic simulation
capabilities.detail: cargo fe2o3 simulate can take ordinary typed source through semantic MIR, verified canonical Kernel IR V7, formal-memory admission, and bounded deterministic CPU execution. The fe2o3 path links and initializes no GPU runtime and performs no GPU enumeration; ordinary project Cargo build scripts remain trusted, unsandboxed host code outside that claim. The current slice covers structured scalar control flow and internal calls, private and global buffers or views, ordinary and guarded scalar loads, D1-D3 invocation identities, static scalar workgroup memory, and convergent workgroup barriers under one cooperative canonical schedule. The result includes copied buffers and a bounded byte-level cross-invocation conflict assessment; a separate adapter can emit observation-only semantic traces. It grants no race-freedom proof, source-to-KIR or GPU equivalence, launch authority, timing, or performance prediction. Floating point, MFMA and wave operations, atomics and fences, dynamic or non-scalar workgroup memory, external calls, memory intrinsics, inline assembly, schedule exploration, and a virtual host runtime remain open in issue #216.
